text:
maria_cs: Quick async standup — HorizonPay renewal demo tomorrow at 10am PT. What I did: confirmed demo scope with customer (live inference, 2 concurrent demo seats). Found they saw 2-3s extra cold-starts on first few tokens during load tests. Blocker: Dedicated pool we promised hasn't been warmed; customer sees poor perf during demo. Ticket: CS-4129.

maria_cs: Note — they use model 'redwood-13b-quant-v2' pinned to 1.2.3 and send ~1.6k token prompts for retrieval+compose. They want consistent sub-200ms token latency during demo; unrealistic without warm cache.

devon_eng: @maria_cs thanks for the context. On it. Can you paste a sample request & the request IDs from their failing runs? I'll check KV cache behavior and autoscaler logs.

maria_cs: sample request (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model":"redwood-13b-quant-v2",
  "input":"<prompt truncated>",
  "max_tokens":512
}
```
Request IDs: rp_20260305_01, rp_20260305_02.

ashwin_se: quick note — if this is cold-start due to quant kernel JIT on a new node, we can pre-warm by running a tiny warm job that touches the kv cache + runs a short generate with the expected seq len. I can supply a warm script.

devon_eng: Copy. @ashwin_se can you drop the warm script here? We might run it as a scheduled job in the customer's dedicated pool an hour before the demo.

ashwin_se: Warm script (example):
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# run from control plane or admin host with access to dedicated pool
for i in {1..3}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-quant-v2","input":"warmup","max_tokens":8}' >/dev/null
done
```
Run 10-15 minutes pre-demo.

julia_cs: @devon_eng @ashwin_se this is urgent for renewal cadence. If demo stalls we risk pushing their decision. Also FYI customer asked about a fallback: if dedicated pool lags, can we route demo traffic to hosted nodes in us-west?

devon_eng: Routing fallback is possible but needs config change and approval. I'll check capacity in hosted us-west now. If we have spare headroom we can set a fallback policy on their route to prefer dedicated then hosted.

maria_cs: blocker for me: I don't have permission to trigger warm script on customer pool. Who owns that runbook?

devon_eng: Ops permission is needed. @srebot can you confirm who to ping for temporary exec access?

srebot: Incident bot: Ops runbook for dedicated pool warm-up is ops/runbooks/dedicated-warmup. Pager duty on-call for infra is @oliver_pm for the next 6 hours.

oliver_pm: I'm on it. @ashwin_se can you hand me the exact pool id / node tags? I'll run the warm-up and add a fallback route if hosted capacity is available.

ashwin_se: Pool id: dp-usw-4t-042. Node tag: rw-dedicated-horizon. Also check logs on nodes: sample error causing slow JIT:
```
[2026-03-05T08:12:34Z] warn: kernel-compile timeout for model redwood-13b-quant-v2 on node n-17, falling back to interpreter path
```
This is why we see token lag spikes.

devon_eng: I'll also open ENG ticket ENG-9045 to track a long-term fix (reduce kernel compile time by caching artifacts). For demo, short-term warm + fallback should be fine.

maria_cs: Today for CS: follow up with customer to set expectation (will prep msg), confirm demo handover at 9:15am with eng, and monitor CS-4129.

julia_cs: I'll draft the customer message: short, transparent, action items. Will share here for review.

devon_eng: Ping me when you have the final message. Also cc me in the run permissions request so I can expedite.

maria_cs: thanks all. If anyone can drop a quick ack when warm script runs, please post here. :thumbsup:

oliver_pm: Warm script run completed at 3171234670 (ran 3 rounds). Observed initial compile but subsequent runs were <120ms per token during smoke test. Routing fallback not needed for demo but remains configured if load spikes.

maria_cs: Amazing — really appreciate the quick turn. I'll update the customer and mark CS-4129 as in-progress.

devon_eng: Leaving ENG stub notes in ENG-9045 and will follow-up tomorrow AM.

julia_cs: Message draft: "Quick update — we found root cause of demo lag and pre-warmed your dedicated pool. We expect consistent latency for the demo tomorrow at 10am PT. We'll monitor live and have a fallback plan if needed." LMK edits.

maria_cs: LGTM. Posting to customer now.

oliver_pm: Closing loop here. If any regression after demo ping this thread and I'll reopen.

maria_cs: End of async standup for this thread.
